controls.Technical Detail: Google Authenticator (TOTP) per autenticazione SSH degli account privilegiati
controls.Debian/Ubuntu Implementation:
1. Installare libpam-google-authenticator:
   apt-get install libpam-google-authenticator
2. Configurare per ogni utente:
   google-authenticator -t -d -f -r 3 -R 30 -w 3
3. Editare /etc/pam.d/sshd, aggiungere:
   auth required pam_google_authenticator.so nullok
4. Editare /etc/ssh/sshd_config:
   ChallengeResponseAuthentication yes
   AuthenticationMethods publickey,keyboard-interactive
5. Riavviare: systemctl restart sshd

2. Configurare Azure MFA:

   reg add "HKLM\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server\WinStations\RDP-Tcp" /v UserAuthentication /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f

controls.Technical Detail: Enforcement password minimum 14 caratteri, complessità, history, aging via PAM
controls.Debian/Ubuntu Implementation:
1. Installare libpam-pwquality:
   apt-get install libpam-pwquality
2. Editare /etc/security/pwquality.conf:
   minlen = 14
   dcredit = -1
   ucredit = -1
   ocredit = -1
   lcredit = -1
   minclass = 4
   maxrepeat = 3
   maxclassrepeat = 4
   gecoscheck = 1
3. Editare /etc/pam.d/common-password:
   password requisite pam_pwquality.so retry=3
4. Password aging in /etc/login.defs:
   PASS_MAX_DAYS 90
   PASS_MIN_DAYS 1
   PASS_WARN_AGE 7
5. Password history in /etc/pam.d/common-password:
   password required pam_pwhistory.so remember=24
controls.RHEL/Oracle Linux Implementation:

   minlen = 14

   ocredit = -1
   lcredit = -1
   minclass = 4
   maxrepeat = 3
   enforcing = 1
2. Editare /etc/pam.d/system-auth e password-auth:
   password requisite pam_pwquality.so try_first_pass local_users_only retry=3 authtok_type=
3. Password aging in /etc/login.defs:
   PASS_MAX_DAYS 90
   PASS_MIN_DAYS 1
   PASS_WARN_AGE 7
4. History: password required pam_pwhistory.so remember=24 use_authtok

   auth required pam_faillock.so authfail deny=5 unlock_time=900

controls.Technical Detail: Lockout account dopo 5 tentativi falliti, unlock automatico dopo 30 minuti
controls.Debian/Ubuntu Implementation:
1. Editare /etc/pam.d/common-auth, aggiungere:
   auth required pam_faillock.so preauth silent audit deny=5 unlock_time=1800
   auth required pam_faillock.so authfail audit deny=5 unlock_time=1800
2. Account module in /etc/pam.d/common-account:
   account required pam_faillock.so
3. Verificare faillock installed:
   apt-get install libpam-modules
4. Configurazione globale /etc/security/faillock.conf:
   deny = 5
   unlock_time = 1800
   audit
   silent

1. faillock già integrato in authselect
2. Configurare /etc/security/faillock.conf:
   deny = 5

3. Se authselect:

   authselect apply-changes
